title: Kvarðinn Worker component diagram
description: The Kvarðinn Worker: a router in front of the static page, room creation, and one authoritative Room Durable Object per code that runs the rules and sends each socket its own view. No sign-in.

components.name: Kvarðinn Worker
components.responsibility: Everything the game runs on the server.

components.name: Router (index.ts)
components.responsibility: Maps BASE onto the routes: POST api/rooms tries up to eight new codes until a Room accepts /init; ws/CODE is passed to that Room; other GETs come from the assets binding, with cache, CSP and other security headers.

components.name: Room codes (codes.ts)
components.responsibility: Four letters from an alphabet without I, O, Q, W, C or Z, from crypto.getRandomValues; CODE_RE checks them.

components.name: Room Durable Object (room.ts)
components.responsibility: Holds one Game in storage; accepts hibernatable WebSockets whose attachments record the seat (or a big screen); handles hello, join, claim, act and ping; broadcasts viewFor() per socket, or only the pointer for drags; deletes itself after two idle days.

components.name: Rules
components.responsibility: act(), addPlayer(), newGame(), viewFor() and parseCards().

components.name: Scale cards (data/kvardar.txt)
components.responsibility: The built-in cards, bundled as text.

components.name: Static assets binding
components.responsibility: Cloudflare's assets for ./dist (binding ASSETS): the page, app.js, style.css and the icon.

components.name: Durable Object storage
components.responsibility: Each Room's game and last-touched time, and its alarm.

relationships.description: Exported from index.ts as class Room (binding ROOMS).
newCode() for a new room; CODE_RE for ws/CODE.
ROOMS.idFromName(code): POST /init, and the WebSocket upgrade.
Every other GET or HEAD, with BASE stripped and redirects kept under BASE.
newGame on /init, addPlayer on join, act on act, viewFor for every broadcast.
Imported as text and parsed once with parseCards().
Reads the game at start-up; writes it after every change; sets the idle alarm.
